title: George Jean Lipsman

page_data.en:
April 21, 1941
795/C
21 H H

George Jean LIPSMAN, Rumanian by birth but
French by naturalization, arrived in Shanghai in January
1941 from Calcutta where for some five years he was General
Manager of the Far Eastern Hotels, Ltd. For many years
prior to that appointment he was general manager of the
Ritz Hotel in Paris. He is an accomplished restaurateur
and has been in the hotel business for many years in
various parts of Europe and the East.

He is said to have left India on account
of ailing health. He has been appointed General Manager
of the Cathay Hotels Ltd. on probation for three months
only and is replacing Mr. Sutor, former General Manager
who recently proceeded to the United States. Until
Mr. Sutor makes known his future plans - whether to
return to Shanghai or not - Lipsman's appointment will
remain purely on probationary lines.

Mr. Telfer has not been replaced and still
occupies his former post at the Cathay Hotel.

Lipsman's task is one connected with the
reorganization of the Cathay Hotels Ltd. from a financial
standpoint, it being an accepted fact that the Cathay Hotels
Ltd. has, for a number of years, been conducted at a loss.

1941年4月21日
795/C
21 H H

乔治·让·利普斯曼（George Jean LIPSMAN），原籍罗马尼亚，后入法国籍，于1941年1月从加尔各答抵达上海。此前约五年间，他担任远东酒店有限公司（Far Eastern Hotels, Ltd.）总经理。在受聘该职之前的多年里，他曾担任巴黎丽兹酒店（Ritz Hotel）总经理。他是一位经验丰富的餐饮经营者，在欧洲和东方的多地从事酒店业多年。

据称，他因健康欠佳而离开印度。他被任命为华懋饭店有限公司（Cathay Hotels Ltd.）总经理，试用期仅为三个月，接替最近前往美国的前任总经理苏托尔先生（Mr. Sutor）。在苏托尔先生明确其未来计划——即是否返回上海——之前，利普斯曼的任命将纯粹保持试用性质。

泰尔弗先生（Mr. Telfer）尚未被接替，仍担任其在华懋饭店的原职。

利普斯曼的任务与华懋饭店有限公司从财务角度进行的重组有关，因为华懋饭店有限公司多年来一直亏损经营，这已是公认的事实。

华懋饭店负责人

乔治·让·利普斯曼先生，
华懋饭店有限公司新任总经理。

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
BR. REGISTRY.
N 79510
Date / /

Information has been obtained from Mr.Lipsman,General Manager,
Cathay Hotels Ltd.,that Sir Victor Sassoon had been approached
by the Japanese who asked him if he would be willing to sell the
Cathay Hotel,Nanking Road.Sir Victor replied that he was willing to
sell and when asked the price gave the prohibitive price of
1,000,000 pounds sterling.Mr Lipsman stated that he was certain that
the strike had been engineered by the Japanese with the object of
reducing the value of the property and inducing Sir Victor to sell
at a price acceptable to the Japanese.
It was further revealed that Mr.Lipsman had received a telephone
call from the Chief of the French Police Political Section informing
him that the strikers were prepared to accept all conditions,as
laid down by Mr Lipsman,and to resume work.Mr Lipsman stated in reply
that he was willing to interview the delegates only on condition
that they were prepared to accept his conditions.He was assured of
this fact and at 5.30.p.m.29-8-41,the delegates came to see him and
flatly refused to have anything to do with his conditions.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
支部登记处
N 79510
日期 / /

据从华懋饭店有限公司总经理利普斯曼先生处获悉，日本人曾接触维克多·沙逊爵士（Sir Victor Sassoon），询问他是否愿意出售位于南京路的华懋饭店。维克多爵士答复称他愿意出售，当被问及价格时，他报出了100万英镑这一令人望而却步的高价。利普斯曼先生表示，他确信此次罢工是由日本人策划的，目的是降低该物业的价值，并促使维克多爵士以日本人可接受的价格出售。

此外还透露，利普斯曼先生曾接到法国警察政治科科长打来的电话，通知他说罢工者准备接受利普斯曼先生提出的所有条件，并复工。利普斯曼先生回复称，他仅愿在罢工者准备接受其条件的情况下会见代表。对方对此事实予以保证，随后在1941年8月29日下午5时30分，代表们前来见他，但断然拒绝与其条件有任何关联。
